Pending owner re-approval; not an approval. Rebuilt for the owner's 2026-10-14 note "cat tails need more close up detail" (eye-level walk mode): LOD0 reed blades and cattails: a 3-sided stalk, a closed 6-sided seed head (flat bottom cap, slight taper, rounded top) and a short pale spike (river_stone slot). Blades are curved strap leaves with rows along the length, a twist, a taper, a shallow V (folded midrib) on the upper side and a flat back sheet on its own vertices, smooth-shaded with a sharp midrib; the longest blade of a clump bends over near its tip, and clumps vary in height, lean and blade count. Stones, placements, slots, the planar UV0 mapping and the masks map are unchanged; LOD1 keeps four flat triangles per clump along LOD0 blades and LOD2 has no reeds, as before. Tris LOD0/1/2 770/298/100 -> 2180/298/100 (the river dressing props' LOD0 ceiling, raised from the prop kind's 1,500 to 2,500 by the owner on 2026-10-14 ("Raise to 2,500")). Cattail heads on LOD0: 30 before, 30 now (two to four per clump, 31 tris each). Review docs/checkpoints/cattails/ (cattails-before-*.jpg against cattails-after-*.jpg, and clump-{before,after}-{front,back}-lit.jpg). The controller records the owner's decision. Earlier entries stay as history.

Pending owner re-approval; not an approval. Rebuilt only to add the plant wind attribute for the owner's 2026-10-14 request ("cattails and wild flowers should be effected by wind also"): UV map `wind` (glTF TEXCOORD_1, FLOAT) on every LOD, U = 0 at each reed blade's and cattail stalk's own base rising to a * sqrt(H / 2 m) at its tip (a the fraction along the plant, H its length; head and spike ride the stalk), V a seeded phase per blade or stalk, 0 on stones and banks. The manifest gives the reed, cattail and (for the cattail spikes) stone slots `wind`, and the kit vertex shaders sway them with the grass's gusts. Review docs/checkpoints/foliage-wind/ (reeds-t*.jpg). Earlier entries stay as history.
